_nota: Consignas de escritura (Fase C, 'Calcomanías oscuro'). Inglés original verificado por Claude; nivelCEFR es una estimación razonada, no una certificación oficial. revisar: true en todas -- Alex debe confirmarlas.

escritura.tema: Cancelar un plan con un amigo
escritura.consigna: Escribe un mensaje a un amigo cancelando un plan que tenían para hoy. Explica por qué y propón otro día.
listaVerificacion: Expliqué por qué cancelo (una razón simple y clara)
Usé un tono amigable e informal
escritura.respuestaModelo: Hey, I'm so sorry, but I can't make it today. I'm feeling a bit sick and I think it's better if I just rest. Can we meet this Saturday instead? I really want to see you, just not today. Let me know if that works!

escritura.consigna: Escribe un correo corto a una escuela de idiomas preguntando información sobre un curso de inglés: horarios, precio y duración.
listaVerificacion: Pregunté por horarios, precio y duración
El correo tiene entre 3 y 5 oraciones
escritura.respuestaModelo: Hello, I'm interested in your English course and I'd like some more information before I sign up. Could you tell me the schedule, the price, and how long the course lasts? I'm available in the evenings, so that information would help me a lot. Thank you for your time.

escritura.consigna: Describe tu rutina diaria: qué haces en la mañana, en la tarde y en la noche. Usa el tiempo presente.
listaVerificacion: Usé palabras de secuencia (first, then, after that, finally)
escritura.respuestaModelo: First, I wake up at seven and have breakfast while I check my phone. Then, in the afternoon, I study or work on my computer for a few hours, and I also try to go for a short walk. After that, I have dinner with my family and watch something before I go to bed. Finally, I read for a little while and fall asleep around eleven.

escritura.consigna: Escribe un mensaje de texto confirmando una cita (puede ser médica, de trabajo o personal) y preguntando la dirección exacta.
listaVerificacion: Confirmé el día y la hora de la cita
El tono es claro y directo
escritura.respuestaModelo: Hi, I just wanted to confirm our appointment for Thursday at 10 a.m. Could you send me the exact address? I want to make sure I arrive on time. See you soon!

escritura.tema: Describir tu lugar de trabajo o estudio
escritura.consigna: Describe el lugar donde trabajas o estudias: cómo es, qué hay en él y por qué te gusta o no te gusta.
listaVerificacion: Describí cómo se ve el lugar (tamaño, colores, muebles)
Mencioné al menos 2 cosas que hay en el lugar
Dije si te gusta o no, y por qué
escritura.respuestaModelo: I usually study in a small room with a desk next to the window. There's a computer, some books, and a lamp I use at night. I like this space because it's quiet and I can focus without many distractions. The only problem is that it gets a little cold in winter.

escritura.tema: Pedir un día libre por correo
escritura.consigna: Escribe un correo corto a tu jefe pidiendo un día libre la próxima semana. Explica brevemente el motivo.
listaVerificacion: Di un motivo breve y apropiado
escritura.respuestaModelo: Hi, I wanted to ask if I could take next Friday off. I have a family matter I need to take care of that day. I'll make sure my tasks are covered before I leave. Thank you for considering it.

escritura.consigna: Escribe un mensaje agradeciendo un regalo que recibiste. Describe el regalo y cómo te sientes.
listaVerificacion: Dije cómo te sientes o cómo lo vas a usar
escritura.respuestaModelo: Thank you so much for the book, I love it! I've wanted to read it for months, so this was a perfect gift. I already started reading it last night and I can't put it down. You always know what I like!

escritura.tema: Describir a un amigo o familiar
escritura.consigna: Describe a un amigo o familiar: cómo es físicamente y cómo es su personalidad.
listaVerificacion: Describí al menos 2 rasgos de personalidad
escritura.respuestaModelo: My sister is tall, with short dark hair and glasses. She's very friendly and always has a positive attitude, even on difficult days. She's also quite organized, which is very different from me. I admire how patient she is with everyone around her.

escritura.tema: Preguntar por el estado de un pedido
escritura.consigna: Escribe un mensaje a una tienda en línea preguntando por el estado de un pedido que hiciste hace una semana.
listaVerificacion: Mencioné que hiciste un pedido y hace cuánto
Pregunté por el estado o la fecha de entrega
escritura.respuestaModelo: Hello, I placed an order a week ago and I haven't received any update since then. Could you tell me the current status and when it might arrive? I'd really appreciate any information you can give me.

escritura.tema: Presentarte a un nuevo compañero de equipo
escritura.consigna: Escribe un correo corto presentándote a un nuevo compañero de equipo. Di tu nombre, qué haces y dale la bienvenida.
listaVerificacion: Dijiste tu nombre y tu rol
Diste la bienvenida al nuevo compañero
escritura.respuestaModelo: Hi, my name is Alex and I work on the design team. Welcome to the company, I'm really glad you joined us! If you have any questions during your first weeks, feel free to reach out to me anytime. Looking forward to working together.

escritura.consigna: Escribe un correo de queja a una tienda sobre un producto que llegó defectuoso. Explica el problema y qué solución esperas.
listaVerificacion: Describí claramente el problema del producto
Mencioné cuándo y dónde lo compraste
Pedí una solución específica (reembolso, cambio, etc.)
Mantuve un tono firme pero educado
escritura.respuestaModelo: I'm writing to report a problem with an order I placed on your website last week. The headphones I bought stopped working after just two days, even though I followed the instructions carefully. I checked the packaging and everything seemed fine, so I don't think it was a mistake on my part. I would like to request a replacement or a full refund, whichever is easier on your end. I've attached a photo of the product and my order number for reference. I hope we can resolve this quickly.

escritura.tema: Narrar un fin de semana memorable
escritura.consigna: Narra un fin de semana que recuerdes especialmente. Qué pasó, con quién estabas y por qué fue memorable.
listaVerificacion: Describí qué pasó en orden cronológico
escritura.respuestaModelo: Last spring, a few friends and I decided to drive to the coast without really planning anything in advance. We got lost twice on the way there, which was frustrating at first but ended up being pretty funny. When we finally arrived, we spent the whole afternoon walking along the beach and talking about everything and nothing. That weekend reminded me how much I needed a break from my usual routine, and I still think about it whenever I feel stressed.

escritura.tema: Proponer una idea a tu equipo
escritura.consigna: Escribe un correo a tu equipo proponiendo una idea para mejorar la forma de trabajar. Explica el problema actual y tu propuesta.
listaVerificacion: Expliqué un beneficio concreto de tu idea
escritura.respuestaModelo: I wanted to share an idea that might help us work more efficiently. Lately, our meetings have been running much longer than planned, and I think it's because we don't always have a clear agenda beforehand. What if we sent a short list of topics the day before each meeting, so everyone knows what to expect and can prepare in advance? I believe this could save us a good amount of time every week. Let me know what you think, and feel free to suggest changes to the idea.

escritura.tema: Describir un problema técnico y su solución
escritura.consigna: Describe un problema técnico que tuviste (con una computadora, una app o un sistema) y cómo lo resolviste.
listaVerificacion: Expliqué los pasos que tomaste para resolverlo
Usé conectores de secuencia (first, then, eventually)
escritura.respuestaModelo: A few weeks ago, my laptop suddenly stopped connecting to the internet, even though other devices worked fine. At first, I tried restarting the router, but that didn't change anything. Then I checked the network settings and noticed the Wi-Fi adapter was disabled for some reason. Eventually, I turned it back on, and everything worked normally again. I'm still not sure what caused it. It was a simple fix, but it took me almost an hour to find it.

escritura.tema: Correo de seguimiento tras una entrevista
escritura.consigna: Escribe un correo de seguimiento después de una entrevista de trabajo, agradeciendo la oportunidad y reafirmando tu interés.
listaVerificacion: Agradeciste el tiempo de la entrevista
Mencionaste algo específico de la conversación
Reafirmaste tu interés en el puesto
escritura.respuestaModelo: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me yesterday about the developer position. I really enjoyed our conversation, especially when we talked about how the team handles code reviews. It confirmed that this is exactly the kind of environment I'm looking for. I remain very interested in the role and would be happy to provide any additional information if needed. I look forward to hearing from you.

escritura.tema: Narrar cómo aprendiste una habilidad nueva
escritura.consigna: Narra cómo aprendiste una habilidad nueva (puede ser técnica o no). Qué dificultades tuviste y cómo las superaste.
listaVerificacion: Mencioné al menos una dificultad real
escritura.respuestaModelo: When I started learning to code, I found it really hard to understand why my programs kept failing for reasons I couldn't see. For the first few weeks, I felt like I was just copying examples without really understanding them. Eventually, I started writing small practice projects on my own instead of only following tutorials, and that made a huge difference. Making my own mistakes taught me more than any lesson did. Now I actually enjoy debugging, which is something I never expected to say.

escritura.tema: Invitar a colegas a un evento
escritura.consigna: Escribe un correo invitando a tus colegas a un evento de la empresa (puede ser una celebración, una capacitación, etc.).
listaVerificacion: Mantuve un tono entusiasta pero profesional
escritura.respuestaModelo: I'm excited to invite you all to our end-of-quarter celebration next Friday at 6 p.m. in the main office. It'll be a relaxed evening with food, drinks, and a chance to catch up outside of our usual meetings. After a busy few months, I think we've definitely earned it. Hope to see everyone there!

escritura.tema: Describir una meta para este año
escritura.consigna: Describe una meta importante que tienes para este año: qué quieres lograr y qué plan tienes para lograrlo.
listaVerificacion: Expliqué por qué es importante para ti
Mencioné al menos un paso concreto de tu plan
escritura.respuestaModelo: One of my main goals this year is to reach a more advanced level of English, especially for speaking. I've noticed that I understand much more than I can actually say in conversations, and that gap bothers me. My plan is to practice speaking a little every day, even if it's just a few minutes, instead of waiting until I feel ready. I also want to have at least one real conversation in English every week. It's a small habit, but I think consistency will make the biggest difference.

escritura.consigna: Escribe un correo pidiendo retroalimentación sobre un proyecto en el que has estado trabajando.
listaVerificacion: Diste un plazo razonable para responder
Mantuviste un tono abierto a las críticas
escritura.respuestaModelo: I wanted to share the latest version of the project I've been working on and ask for your feedback. I'm particularly interested in whether the structure makes sense and if anything feels confusing to a new user. Any comments, even small ones, would be really helpful. If possible, I'd love to hear back by the end of the week, since I'd like to make adjustments before the next review.

escritura.tema: Narrar un día difícil en el trabajo
escritura.consigna: Narra un día difícil que tuviste en el trabajo o la escuela, y cómo lo manejaste.
listaVerificacion: Describí qué hizo el día difícil
Expliqué cómo reaccionaste o lo resolviste
escritura.respuestaModelo: Last month, I had a day where almost everything went wrong at once: a meeting got moved without warning, I lost part of my work due to a technical issue, and I was already behind on a deadline. Instead of trying to fix everything at the same time, I decided to stop for a moment and write down what actually needed to happen that day. That helped me focus on one thing instead of panicking about all of it. By the end of the day, I hadn't solved every problem, but I felt much calmer about it.

escritura.tema: Opinión: ¿la IA debería reemplazar trabajos humanos?
escritura.consigna: Escribe tu opinión sobre si la inteligencia artificial debería reemplazar trabajos que hoy hacen personas. Da al menos un argumento a favor y uno en contra antes de concluir.
listaVerificacion: Presenté un argumento a favor claramente
Presenté un argumento en contra claramente
Di mi propia conclusión al final
Usé conectores de contraste (however, on the other hand)
escritura.respuestaModelo: There's a strong case for automating repetitive or dangerous tasks: it can increase efficiency and free people from work that offers little personal fulfillment. On the other hand, replacing jobs too quickly can leave workers without the time or resources to retrain for new roles, which deepens inequality rather than reducing it. In my opinion, the goal shouldn't be replacement for its own sake, but automation paired with real support for the people affected. Technology that improves efficiency without a plan for the people it displaces solves one problem by creating another.

escritura.tema: Argumento sobre el trabajo remoto permanente
escritura.consigna: Escribe un argumento a favor o en contra de que el trabajo remoto se vuelva la norma permanente en la industria tecnológica. Defiende tu postura con razones claras.
listaVerificacion: Tomé una postura clara (a favor o en contra)
Di al menos dos razones que la apoyan
Consideré al menos una objeción y la respondí
escritura.respuestaModelo: I believe remote work should remain the default option in tech, not just a temporary arrangement. First, it removes the time and cost of commuting, which gives people more control over their own schedules. Second, it allows companies to hire talented people regardless of where they live, instead of limiting the search to one city. Some argue that remote work weakens team collaboration, and that's a fair concern, but it's one that can be addressed with intentional communication habits rather than by forcing everyone back into an office. The flexibility it offers is simply too valuable to give up by default.

escritura.tema: Opinión sobre la ética de recopilar datos de usuarios
escritura.consigna: Escribe tu opinión sobre los límites éticos que deberían existir al recopilar datos de usuarios en apps y sitios web.
listaVerificacion: Expliqué por qué el tema importa
Propuse al menos un límite ético concreto
Consideré el punto de vista de las empresas
escritura.respuestaModelo: Data collection isn't inherently wrong, but the way many companies handle it crosses a line that users rarely notice until it's too late. Personally, I think the clearest ethical limit is consent that's actually informed, not just a checkbox buried in a long terms-of-service document nobody reads. Companies will argue that detailed data helps them improve their products, and that's often true, but usefulness doesn't automatically justify collecting more than what's needed. A reasonable middle ground would be collecting only what's necessary for the service to work, and being transparent about anything beyond that.

escritura.tema: Argumento sobre enseñar IA desde el inicio en la universidad
escritura.consigna: Argumenta a favor o en contra de que las universidades enseñen inteligencia artificial desde los primeros semestres de cualquier carrera de ingeniería.
listaVerificacion: Di al menos dos razones concretas
Mencioné un riesgo o límite de tu propia postura
escritura.respuestaModelo: I think AI fundamentals should be introduced early, even outside of specialized programs. Students who understand the basics sooner are better prepared to use these tools critically instead of treating them as magic, and that habit is hard to build later once other ways of thinking are already set. At the same time, there's a real risk of rushing students into advanced topics before they have a solid foundation in math and programming, which could do more harm than good. The solution isn't skipping the basics, but weaving AI concepts into existing courses gradually, so students build both skills at the same time instead of one after the other.

escritura.tema: Opinión sobre el equilibrio vida-trabajo en tecnología
escritura.consigna: Escribe tu opinión sobre la cultura de trabajo en la industria tecnológica respecto al equilibrio entre la vida personal y laboral.
listaVerificacion: Describí un problema específico de esa cultura
escritura.respuestaModelo: The tech industry often praises long hours as a sign of dedication, but I think that mindset causes more harm than it admits. Treating constant availability as a virtue makes it harder for people to set healthy boundaries, even when the actual workload doesn't require it. In my view, companies that genuinely care about long-term performance should measure results instead of hours spent online. A simple improvement would be normalizing clear response-time expectations, so people don't feel guilty for logging off at a reasonable time.

escritura.tema: Argumento sobre certificaciones vs. experiencia práctica
escritura.consigna: Argumenta si las certificaciones técnicas son más o menos importantes que la experiencia práctica al contratar a alguien en tecnología.
listaVerificacion: Comparé ambos lados con ejemplos o razones
Reconocí el valor del lado contrario
escritura.respuestaModelo: While certifications can prove that someone has studied a specific topic, I don't think they're as valuable as practical experience when it comes to actually doing the job. Experience shows how someone handles unexpected problems, works with a team, and makes decisions under real constraints, none of which a certification can fully measure. That said, certifications aren't useless: they can help someone break into a field where they have no professional history yet, which is a real barrier for many people. Ideally, hiring decisions should weigh both, but when I have to choose, real-world experience tells me more about how someone will actually perform.

escritura.tema: Opinión sobre redes sociales y productividad
escritura.consigna: Escribe tu opinión sobre cómo las redes sociales afectan la productividad de las personas que trabajan o estudian con una computadora.
listaVerificacion: Expliqué el impacto (positivo, negativo, o ambos)
escritura.respuestaModelo: Social media isn't purely a distraction, but I think its design makes it especially hard to use in moderation while working. Notifications are built to interrupt, and even a quick check can break the concentration it took several minutes to build in the first place. I've noticed this myself: a single five-minute break can easily turn into twenty once I start scrolling. What has helped me is keeping those apps off my work computer entirely, so checking them requires a deliberate choice instead of a habit I don't even notice.

escritura.tema: Argumento sobre código abierto vs. software propietario
escritura.consigna: Argumenta si el software de código abierto es mejor que el software propietario para proyectos importantes de una empresa.
listaVerificacion: Di al menos dos razones concretas
Consideré un caso donde la otra opción sea mejor
escritura.respuestaModelo: For most internal tools, I lean toward open-source software, mainly because of transparency: anyone can inspect the code, which makes it easier to catch security issues before they become serious problems. It also avoids being locked into a single vendor who might change pricing or discontinue support with little warning. Still, proprietary software can make sense when a company needs guaranteed support and accountability, something that's harder to get from a loosely maintained open-source project. In the end, the right choice depends less on ideology and more on how critical the tool is and who's responsible for keeping it running.

escritura.tema: Opinión sobre la automatización en la industria
escritura.consigna: Escribe tu opinión sobre el ritmo al que se está automatizando la industria y qué tan preparada está la sociedad para ese cambio.
listaVerificacion: Di tu opinión sobre el ritmo de automatización
Expliqué si la sociedad está preparada o no
Propuse algo que ayudaría a prepararse mejor
escritura.respuestaModelo: Automation itself isn't the problem; the speed at which it's happening compared to how slowly institutions adapt is what concerns me. New tools can replace entire workflows within a year, while retraining programs and education systems take much longer to catch up. I don't think society is fully prepared for that gap, especially in industries where workers have spent years building a single specialized skill. What would help most isn't slowing down innovation, but investing much earlier in flexible education that teaches people how to keep learning, not just one fixed set of skills.

escritura.tema: Argumento a favor o en contra de los daily standups
escritura.consigna: Argumenta a favor o en contra de las reuniones diarias de pie (daily standups) como práctica estándar en equipos de desarrollo.
listaVerificacion: Di al menos dos razones concretas
Reconocí una desventaja real de tu propia postura
escritura.respuestaModelo: I'm generally in favor of daily standups, but only when they're kept genuinely short and focused. They give the whole team quick visibility into what everyone is working on, which makes it much easier to notice blockers before they cause real delays. They also create a small, low-pressure habit of communication that can prevent bigger misunderstandings later in the week. The main downside is that they can easily turn into status reports for a manager instead of a tool for the team itself, which defeats their purpose. When that happens, the problem isn't the format, it's how the meeting is actually run.

escritura.consigna: Escribe una presentación corta: tu nombre, tu edad, de dónde eres y a qué te dedicas.
escritura.respuestaModelo: Hello! My name is Alex. I am twenty-three years old. I am from Mexico. I am a student. I study computers. Nice to meet you!

escritura.consigna: Escribe sobre tu familia: quiénes son y cómo se llaman (por ejemplo, tu mamá, tu papá, tus hermanos).
listaVerificacion: Nombré al menos a 3 personas de mi familia
Dije una cosa de cada persona
escritura.respuestaModelo: I have a small family. My mother is Laura. My father is Carlos. I have one sister. Her name is Ana. She is twelve years old. I love my family.

escritura.consigna: Escribe qué haces en un día normal: a qué hora te despiertas, qué comes y a qué hora duermes.
listaVerificacion: Dije a qué hora me despierto
escritura.respuestaModelo: I wake up at seven. I eat bread and eggs for breakfast. I go to school at eight. I have lunch at one. I do my homework at six. I go to bed at ten.

escritura.consigna: Escribe cómo es tu casa o tu cuarto: qué habitaciones o cosas hay.
listaVerificacion: Dije qué habitaciones o cosas hay
Dije cuál es mi lugar favorito
escritura.respuestaModelo: My house is small. There are two bedrooms and one kitchen. There is a big table in the kitchen. My favorite room is my bedroom. It is quiet.

escritura.consigna: Escribe un mensaje a un amigo para invitarlo a tomar un café mañana.
listaVerificacion: Dije el día y la hora
escritura.respuestaModelo: Hi Tom! Do you want to have coffee tomorrow? I am free at four o'clock. Can you come? See you!

escritura.consigna: Escribe sobre la comida que te gusta y la que no te gusta.
listaVerificacion: Dije una comida que me gusta ('I like...')
Dije una comida que no me gusta ('I don't like...')
escritura.respuestaModelo: I like rice and chicken. I eat it for lunch. I like apples, too. I don't like fish. My favorite drink is orange juice.

escritura.consigna: Escribe cómo es un amigo o una amiga: cómo se llama, cómo es y qué le gusta hacer.
escritura.respuestaModelo: My friend is Maria. She is tall and kind. She is twenty years old. She likes music and football. We are good friends.

escritura.consigna: Escribe a qué te dedicas: dónde trabajas o estudias y qué haces ahí.
escritura.respuestaModelo: I am a student. I study at a big school. I go to class from Monday to Friday. I read and write every day. I like my classes.

escritura.consigna: Escribe qué haces normalmente el sábado o el domingo.
escritura.respuestaModelo: On Saturday, I wake up late. I clean my room. In the afternoon, I meet my friends at the park. We talk and walk. I go home at six.

escritura.consigna: Escribe un mensaje corto a un compañero para pedirle prestado un libro y decirle cuándo lo devuelves.
escritura.respuestaModelo: Hi Sam! Can I borrow your English book, please? I need it today. I can give it back tomorrow. Thank you!

escritura.consigna: Escribe sobre la ciudad o el pueblo donde vives: cómo es y qué hay.
listaVerificacion: Dije cómo se llama mi ciudad
Dije si me gusta y por qué
escritura.respuestaModelo: I live in Puebla. It is a big city, but it is very nice. There is a big park near my house. There are many small restaurants and a big market. I like my city because the food is good.

escritura.consigna: Escribe sobre tu día favorito de la semana y qué haces ese día.
listaVerificacion: Dije cuál es mi día favorito
Dije dos cosas que hago ese día
escritura.respuestaModelo: My favorite day is Saturday. I wake up late and eat a big breakfast. In the afternoon, I play football with my friends. In the evening, I watch a movie with my family. I love Saturdays.

escritura.tema: Recomendar un restaurante a un amigo
escritura.consigna: Escribe un mensaje a un amigo recomendándole un restaurante que te gusta. Di qué comida tiene y por qué vale la pena.
listaVerificacion: Dije el nombre o el tipo de restaurante
Mencioné al menos una comida o bebida
escritura.respuestaModelo: Hey, you have to try Casa Lola! It's a small restaurant near the university, and the tacos are amazing. The prices are low and the people are really friendly. Let's go together on Friday if you're free!

escritura.consigna: Escribe un mensaje a un compañero de trabajo o de clase pidiendo disculpas porque llegaste tarde a una reunión. Explica brevemente por qué.
listaVerificacion: Expliqué el motivo en una frase
Dije qué voy a hacer para compensarlo
escritura.respuestaModelo: Hi Sam, I'm really sorry I was late to the meeting this morning. My bus broke down and I had to walk to the office. I read the notes you sent, and I'll finish my part before the end of the day. Thanks for your patience.

escritura.consigna: Escribe instrucciones paso a paso para algo que sabes hacer (por ejemplo, usar una app, preparar un platillo o configurar un programa).
listaVerificacion: Usé palabras de secuencia (first, then, after that, finally)
Cada paso es claro y corto
Incluí un consejo o una advertencia
escritura.respuestaModelo: Here's how to share your screen in a video call. First, open the meeting and click the button at the bottom of the window. Then choose whether you want to share the whole screen or only one window. After that, make sure your notifications are turned off, so nobody sees your private messages. Finally, click "Share" and wait a few seconds. If something goes wrong, stop sharing and try again.

escritura.consigna: Describe una película o serie que viste recientemente: de qué trata, qué te gustó y si la recomendarías.
listaVerificacion: Resumí la historia sin contar el final
Dije al menos una cosa que me gustó
Dije si la recomiendo y a quién
escritura.respuestaModelo: Last week I watched a documentary about how large cities are changing their transport systems. It follows three engineers who try to reduce traffic without building more roads. I liked that it showed real problems instead of simple answers. It was a little slow in the middle, but the ending made it worth it. I'd recommend it to anyone interested in cities or technology.

escritura.tema: Responder a una crítica en el trabajo
escritura.consigna: Escribe un correo respondiendo a una crítica que recibiste sobre tu trabajo. Reconoce lo que es válido, explica tu punto de vista y propone cómo mejorar.
listaVerificacion: Reconocí lo que es válido de la crítica
Expliqué mi punto de vista con calma
Propuse una acción concreta para mejorar
escritura.respuestaModelo: Thank you for your detailed comments on the report. You're right that the second section is too long and could confuse readers, and I'll shorten it this week. On the other hand, I'd like to explain why I included the extra data: the client asked specifically for that comparison during our last call. I understand the concern, though, so I'll move that material to an appendix. I'd also welcome a short conversation to agree on the structure before the next version.

escritura.tema: Argumento sobre la semana laboral de cuatro días
escritura.consigna: Argumenta a favor o en contra de la semana laboral de cuatro días. Da razones claras y responde a una objeción.
listaVerificacion: Di al menos dos razones concretas
Consideré una objeción y la respondí
Usé conectores de contraste y de conclusión
escritura.respuestaModelo: I believe a four-day work week is worth trying in most office jobs. Firstly, several pilot programs have shown that productivity stays stable, because people waste less time on unnecessary meetings. Secondly, an extra day of rest reduces burnout, which is costly for any company. Some argue that clients expect service five days a week, and that is a fair concern. However, it can be solved with shifts, so that someone is always available. In the end, results matter more than hours.

escritura.tema: Carta de motivación para un posgrado
escritura.consigna: Escribe un párrafo de una carta de motivación para un posgrado en tu área. Explica qué te interesa investigar, qué experiencia previa tienes y qué esperas aportar.
listaVerificacion: Expliqué mi interés académico con precisión
Dije qué espero aportar, no solo recibir
Usé un registro formal y matizado
escritura.respuestaModelo: My interest in machine learning began during an undergraduate project in which a model we trained performed well on average but failed on a minority of cases. That experience led me to ask not only how accurate a system is, but for whom it works. Since then, I have worked on evaluation methods for a university research group, and I would like to pursue this question more rigorously. I hope to contribute careful empirical work, and I would value the chance to learn from a department that takes both technical depth and social impact seriously.

escritura.consigna: Escribe una reseña crítica breve de un artículo o libro que hayas leído. Resume la idea principal, evalúa sus puntos fuertes y débiles y da tu valoración final.
listaVerificacion: Resumí la idea principal con claridad
Señalé al menos un punto fuerte
Señalé al menos una debilidad con argumentos
escritura.respuestaModelo: The article argues that remote work weakens the informal exchange of ideas that drives innovation. Its strongest point is the use of real communication data rather than anecdote. However, the sample consists mainly of large technology firms, which limits how far the conclusions can be generalized. The author also treats office interaction as uniformly beneficial, which seems optimistic. Overall, it is a useful contribution, albeit one that should be read with some caution.

escritura.tema: Propuesta de mejora de un proceso
escritura.consigna: Escribe una propuesta breve para mejorar un proceso de tu trabajo, escuela o equipo. Describe el problema, tu propuesta, los beneficios y un posible riesgo.
listaVerificacion: Describí el problema con datos o ejemplos
Mencioné un riesgo y cómo reducirlo
Usé un tono persuasivo y profesional
escritura.respuestaModelo: Our current review process requires every change to be approved by two senior engineers, which has created a backlog of nearly a week. I propose that low-risk changes be approved by a single reviewer, while critical ones keep the two-person rule. This should reduce waiting time considerably without compromising quality where it matters most. The main risk is inconsistency between reviewers, which we could limit with a short checklist. I suggest trying the new approach for one month and reviewing the results together.

escritura.consigna: Escribe un correo rechazando una solicitud (por ejemplo, una propuesta, una petición de fecha o una oferta) de manera clara pero amable, y ofrece una alternativa.
listaVerificacion: Dije que no con claridad, sin ambigüedad
Expliqué el motivo sin dar demasiados detalles
Mantuve un tono cordial y formal
escritura.respuestaModelo: Thank you for thinking of me for this project; I'm genuinely flattered. Unfortunately, I won't be able to take it on, as my schedule is already full until the end of the quarter, and I wouldn't want to deliver less than my best. If it would help, I'd be glad to recommend a colleague who has the right experience. I'd also be happy to be considered for similar work in the autumn. I appreciate your understanding.

escritura.consigna: Escribe un resumen ejecutivo breve (para alguien que no leerá el informe completo) sobre un proyecto, estudio o resultado reciente.
listaVerificacion: Incluí dos o tres datos clave
Dije qué decisión o acción se recomienda
escritura.respuestaModelo: This report concludes that migrating our customer support to the new platform is feasible and cost-effective. In a three-month pilot, response times fell by almost a third, and customer satisfaction remained stable. The main risk is the training required for staff, which we estimate at two weeks. We therefore recommend a gradual rollout beginning with the smallest team, followed by a review before wider adoption.

escritura.tema: Ensayo de opinión: la IA en el aula
escritura.consigna: Escribe un texto de opinión sobre el uso de herramientas de inteligencia artificial en el aula. Presenta tu postura, concede un punto a la otra posición y concluye.
listaVerificacion: Concedí un punto válido de la posición contraria
Usé conectores de contraste (although, however, whereas)
escritura.respuestaModelo: Although some teachers fear that artificial intelligence will encourage laziness, I believe that banning it would be a mistake. Students will use these tools in their working lives, and learning to use them critically is part of a modern education. It is true that a student who copies an answer learns nothing. However, the same could be said of copying from a textbook. The real question is how assignments are designed. If tasks reward reasoning rather than polished text, the tool becomes an aid rather than a shortcut.

escritura.tema: Responder a la queja de un cliente
escritura.consigna: Escribe una respuesta a un cliente molesto cuyo pedido llegó tarde. Pide disculpas, explica lo ocurrido sin poner excusas y ofrece una solución concreta.
escritura.respuestaModelo: Thank you for bringing this to our attention, and please accept our sincere apologies for the delay. Your order was held up at our distribution center because of an error in our system, and we should have contacted you sooner. We have now expedited the shipment, and it should reach you by Thursday. As a gesture of goodwill, we will refund the delivery fee. If anything else goes wrong, please contact me directly.

escritura.consigna: Describe una tendencia que viste en una gráfica o en datos (por ejemplo, ventas, usuarios, calificaciones). Explica qué cambió, posibles causas y una cautela.
listaVerificacion: Describí el cambio principal con precisión
Usé vocabulario de tendencias (rise, decline, fluctuate)
Añadí una cautela sobre los datos
escritura.respuestaModelo: Over the past year, weekly active users rose steadily until March, then dropped sharply in April before stabilizing. The decline coincides with a change in the sign-up process, which may have discouraged new users. However, it is too early to draw firm conclusions, since the data covers only a few weeks after the change. It would be worth comparing these figures with those of last April to rule out seasonal effects.

escritura.consigna: Escribe una carta breve al editor de un periódico respondiendo a un artículo que te hizo reaccionar. Menciona el artículo, expresa tu desacuerdo con respeto y da un argumento.
listaVerificacion: Mencioné el artículo al que respondo
Di al menos un argumento sólido
escritura.respuestaModelo: I am writing in response to your recent article on university fees. While I agree that the current system is flawed, I disagree that abolishing fees would make education fairer. Without sufficient public funding, universities would be forced to limit places, and those with the fewest resources would suffer first. A more targeted approach, with grants for low-income students, seems both fairer and more realistic. I would welcome a debate on this subject.

escritura.consigna: Escribe un informe breve sobre un problema o incidente (técnico o de otro tipo): qué ocurrió, la causa, cómo se resolvió y qué se hará para evitarlo.
listaVerificacion: Propuse una medida para evitar que se repita
Usé un tono objetivo, sin culpar a nadie
escritura.respuestaModelo: On Tuesday at nine in the morning, the booking system became unavailable for roughly forty minutes. The cause was an expired security certificate that nobody had been assigned to renew. Service was restored once the certificate was replaced. To prevent a recurrence, we will add an automatic alert thirty days before any certificate expires, and assign a named owner to each one.

escritura.consigna: Escribe una recomendación de un libro, película, curso o herramienta, con sus puntos fuertes y sus limitaciones, para un lector que decide si le conviene.
listaVerificacion: Dije qué es y para quién sirve
escritura.respuestaModelo: This online course is an excellent introduction to statistics, provided you are comfortable with basic algebra. The explanations are clear, and the exercises build gradually. Its main limitation is that it offers little guidance on real datasets, so you may need to practice elsewhere. I would recommend it to anyone starting out, but not to those who already have a solid background.

escritura.consigna: Escribe un párrafo argumentativo sobre un tema que te interese (tecnología, educación, trabajo o sociedad). Defiende una postura, presenta el mejor contraargumento y respóndele con precisión.
listaVerificacion: Mi postura es clara y está bien delimitada
Presenté el contraargumento más fuerte, no uno débil
Mantuve un registro formal y natural
escritura.respuestaModelo: It is often claimed that automation will inevitably widen inequality, and the concern is not unreasonable. Yet the claim assumes that the gains from new technology are fixed in their distribution, which history does not support. Where unions, public education and fair taxation have been strong, the benefits have been shared more widely. The more defensible position is therefore not that automation causes inequality, but that it magnifies whatever institutions already exist to absorb it.

escritura.consigna: Escribe una crítica razonada de una idea muy popular (por ejemplo, 'hay que seguir tu pasión' o 'más datos siempre es mejor'). Explica qué tiene de cierto y dónde se queda corta.
listaVerificacion: Reconocí lo que la idea tiene de cierto
Expliqué dónde falla o se queda corta
Usé un ejemplo o un contraejemplo
escritura.respuestaModelo: The advice to follow your passion contains a grain of truth: people who care about their work tend to persist. But it quietly assumes that passion exists in advance, waiting to be discovered, when it often grows out of competence and attention. A young engineer who feels indifferent to a field may simply not have reached the point where it becomes interesting. Better advice might be to follow your curiosity, and to be patient enough for it to find something worth caring about.

escritura.consigna: Escribe un discurso breve (para decir en voz alta) agradeciendo un reconocimiento, por ejemplo un premio de tu equipo o escuela. Debe sonar natural, humilde y con un toque de humor.
listaVerificacion: Agradecí con sinceridad y sin exagerar
Incluí un toque de humor ligero
Sonó natural al leerlo en voz alta
escritura.respuestaModelo: I wasn't expecting this, and I'm afraid I haven't prepared anything clever, which my team will tell you is entirely in character. This award belongs to all of them, who put up with my emails at midnight and my love of long meetings. What I've learned is that good work is rarely done alone, however much our job titles suggest otherwise. So thank you. I promise to use this power only for good, or at least for better coffee.

escritura.consigna: Escribe un correo a un superior en el que expreses con respeto un desacuerdo con una decisión, sin sonar a reproche, y propongas revisarla.
listaVerificacion: Reconocí la intención o la lógica de la decisión
Expresé el desacuerdo con claridad y respeto
Di una razón concreta, no solo una opinión
Propuse revisar o probar una alternativa
escritura.respuestaModelo: Thank you for explaining the reasoning behind the new schedule; I can see why it appeals from a planning perspective. I would nonetheless like to raise one concern: moving the deadline earlier leaves almost no time for testing, which may cost us more later than it saves now. I may be missing information, so I would welcome your view. Might it be worth reviewing the plan together before we commit?

escritura.consigna: Resume un estudio o artículo científico (real o imaginario) y evalúa críticamente sus métodos y conclusiones, distinguiendo lo que demuestra de lo que solo sugiere.
listaVerificacion: Resumí la pregunta y el método con precisión
Distinguí lo demostrado de lo sugerido
escritura.respuestaModelo: The study examines whether a four-week mindfulness course improves students' concentration. Participants who completed the course scored higher on an attention test than those who did not. The result is suggestive, but several limitations temper it: participants chose whether to join, so motivation may explain the difference, and the effect was measured only once. The authors are appropriately cautious, yet the media coverage has been far less so. A longer randomized trial would be needed to say more.

escritura.consigna: Escribe una propuesta breve de una norma o política para una escuela, empresa o comunidad. Justifica su necesidad, anticipa críticas y explica cómo evaluarías si funciona.
listaVerificacion: Justifiqué por qué hace falta la norma
Propuse un criterio para evaluar si funciona
Mi redacción es precisa y bien organizada
escritura.respuestaModelo: We propose that all course materials be made available online at least one week before each term begins. The current practice of releasing them gradually disadvantages students who work part-time or need extra preparation. Some instructors may object that this reduces flexibility, and we acknowledge the concern; materials could be marked provisional where necessary. After one academic year, the policy should be assessed using student surveys and the number of late-enrollment complaints.

escritura.consigna: Escribe un párrafo de un artículo de opinión sobre la privacidad digital. Evita los tópicos: busca un ángulo propio y respáldalo con una idea concreta.
listaVerificacion: Tuve un ángulo propio, no un lugar común
Respaldé la idea con un ejemplo concreto
Usé un registro de opinión pulido
Cerré con una idea que invite a pensar
escritura.respuestaModelo: We tend to describe privacy as something we own, like a possession that careless people leave unlocked. That framing is convenient for companies, because it makes every leak the user's fault. Privacy is better understood as a relationship: what I tell a doctor, a bank or a friend carries expectations about how it will be used. When those expectations are routinely ignored, the problem is not a careless individual but a broken agreement.

escritura.consigna: Escribe una carta breve de renuncia a un trabajo o a un cargo voluntario. Debe ser cordial, no dejar puertas cerradas y evitar tanto los reproches como la adulación excesiva.
listaVerificacion: Mantuve un tono sobrio y cordial
escritura.respuestaModelo: I am writing to inform you of my decision to resign from my position, effective at the end of next month. I am grateful for the trust placed in me, and particularly for the opportunity to lead the migration project. To ensure a smooth transition, I will document my current tasks and am happy to help train my successor. I have valued my time here and hope to stay in touch.

escritura.tema: Explicar un tema técnico al público general
escritura.consigna: Explica en un párrafo un concepto técnico o científico (por ejemplo, cómo funciona un modelo de lenguaje o un algoritmo) a un público general, sin jerga y sin perder precisión.
listaVerificacion: Evité la jerga o la expliqué
escritura.respuestaModelo: A language model works a little like an extremely well-read person who has learned which words tend to follow which. Given the start of a sentence, it estimates what is most likely to come next, one piece at a time. This is why it can sound fluent on almost any subject. The important caveat is that fluency is not understanding: the model has no direct way of checking whether what it says is true.

escritura.consigna: Compara dos enfoques para resolver el mismo problema (dos métodos de estudio, dos herramientas o dos formas de organizar un equipo). Evita elegir uno sin matices.
listaVerificacion: Señalé ventajas y costos de cada uno
Indiqué en qué contexto conviene cada uno
escritura.respuestaModelo: Centralized teams offer consistency, since decisions pass through a single point, whereas autonomous teams tend to move faster because they decide for themselves. The former suits situations in which errors are costly; the latter, those in which speed and local knowledge matter most. Neither is superior in the abstract. What matters is whether the organization is honest about which of the two problems it actually has.

escritura.consigna: Escribe la introducción de un informe breve sobre un tema que conozcas. Debe presentar el problema, el alcance y lo que el lector encontrará, con una voz sobria y clara.
listaVerificacion: Delimité el alcance (qué incluye y qué no)
Mantuve un registro formal y preciso
escritura.respuestaModelo: This report examines how small engineering teams manage technical risk when launching new products. It focuses on practices that require little investment, and does not consider regulatory requirements, which vary by country. The first section describes the problem; the second reviews three common approaches; the third offers recommendations. Throughout, the aim is to be practical rather than exhaustive.

escritura.consigna: Escribe una breve reflexión personal sobre un error que cometiste y lo que realmente cambió en ti. Evita la moraleja fácil: busca una conclusión honesta.
listaVerificacion: Describí el error sin justificarlo de más
Usé un tono honesto y sereno
escritura.respuestaModelo: Looking back, my mistake was not the missed deadline but the weeks of optimism that preceded it. I had sensed the project was slipping and chose not to say so, partly out of pride. What changed was less my planning than my willingness to say early, and somewhat awkwardly, that something is not working. It is not a dramatic lesson, but it has been the most useful one.

escritura.consigna: Escribe un correo formal a un profesor o exjefe pidiéndole una carta de recomendación. Recuérdale cómo lo conoces, explica para qué la necesitas y facilita su respuesta.
listaVerificacion: Recordé cómo conozco a la persona
Expliqué para qué necesito la carta y la fecha límite
Le di una salida cortés si no puede
Usé un registro formal y cordial
escritura.respuestaModelo: I hope you are well. I took your course on data structures two years ago, and I am now applying for a master's program in computer science. Would you be willing to write a letter of recommendation on my behalf? The deadline is the fifteenth of March, and I have attached my résumé and a short summary of the project we discussed. I fully understand if your schedule makes this difficult, and I am grateful for any consideration.
